doc:
# Spin Chain — Integrability

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “spin chain N=4 super Yang-Mills”).

claims.name: construction_extends_so_spin_chain
claims.statement: This construction extends the $SO(6)$ spin chain picture of $N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory.

sources.title: Integrable Spin Chains on the Conformal Moose

claims.name: classical_sl_spin_chain_arises
claims.statement: The classical SL(2,R) spin chain arises in the large-spin limit of N=4 Super Yang-Mills theory.

sources.title: A Spin Chain from String Theory

claims.name: superconformal_determination_spinchain_hamiltonian_analogous
claims.statement: The superconformal determination of the spin-chain Hamiltonian is analogous to the situation in $N=4$ Super Yang-Mills.

sources.title: The Complete One-loop Spin Chain of N =1 SQCD

claims.name: construction_includes_super_spin_chain
claims.statement: The construction includes the super spin chain of planar $ \mathcal{N}=4 $ super Yang-Mills theory at one loop with a diagonal twist.

sources.title: Evaluation of the operatorial Q-system for non-compact super spin chains

claims.name: reflection_amplitudes_magnon_boundstates_off
claims.statement: Reflection amplitudes of magnon bound-states off giant gravitons are computed in the $N=4$ super Yang-Mills spin chain.

claims.name: wrapping_obstructs_spinchain_formulation_operator
claims.statement: Wrapping obstructs the spin-chain formulation of the operator spectrum in $N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory for short chain length at high loop order.

claims.name: complete_oneloop_planar_dilatation_generator
claims.statement: The complete one-loop planar dilatation generator of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills is described by an integrable $\mathfrak{su}(2,2|4)$ super spin chain.

sources.title: The N=4 SYM Integrable Super Spin Chain

claims.name: derive_investigate_smatrix_su_dynamic
claims.statement: We derive and investigate the S-matrix for the su(2|3) dynamic spin chain and for planar N=4 super Yang-Mills.

claims.name: operators_mathcal_super_yang_mills
claims.statement: Operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang Mills with large R-charge can be studied via spin chain problems in the planar limit.

claims.name: integrable_structure_appears_planar_superyangmills
claims.statement: Integrable structure appears in planar $N = 4$ super-Yang-Mills as the identification of the dilatation generator with an integrable quantum spin-chain Hamiltonian.

claims.name: first_nontrivial_conserved_charge_spin
claims.statement: The first non-trivial conserved charge of the spin chain translates into an ``axial’’ symmetry of $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills theory at $N=\infty\,. $

sources.title: The Dilatation Operator of Conformal N=4 Super Yang-Mills Theory

claims.name: continuum_limit_planar_fishnet_diagrams
claims.statement: The continuum limit of 4d planar fishnet diagrams is considered using integrable spin chain methods borrowed from the $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 Super-Yang-Mills theory.

sources.title: Continuum limit of fishnet graphs and AdS sigma model

claims.name: standard_bethe_ansatze_may_remain
claims.statement: Standard Bethe Ansatze may remain applicable to spin-chain descriptions of deformed $\mathcal N=4$ Super-Yang-Mills theory dual to non-diagonal TsT models.

sources.title: Regularising Spectral Curves for Homogeneous Yang-Baxter strings

claims.name: sigma_model_describes_thermodynamic_limit
claims.statement: That sigma model describes the thermodynamic limit of the spin-chain Hamiltonian from the complete one-loop dilatation operator of $N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory.

sources.title: Landau-Lifshitz sigma-models, fermions and the AdS/CFT correspondence

claims.name: quantum_bethe_equations_reproduce_quantum
claims.statement: The quantum Bethe equations reproduce a quantum homogeneous spin chain similar to the one describing the bosonic sector of one-loop N=4 super Yang-Mills theory.

sources.title: Strings as Multi-Particle States of Quantum Sigma-Models

claims.name: undeformed_seed_model_sector_mathfrak
claims.statement: The undeformed seed model is a sector of the $ \mathfrak{psu} $(2, 2|4)-invariant spin-chain encoding the one-loop planar spectral problem of $ \mathcal{N} $ = 4 super Yang-Mills.

sources.title: Jordanian deformation of the non-compact and $\mathfrak{sl}_2 $-invariant $XXX_{-1/2}$ spin-chain

claims.name: planar_limit_superyangmills_theory_operator
claims.statement: In the planar limit of $N=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory, operator dimensions can be simplified by mapping the dilatation generator to the Hamiltonian of an integrable spin chain.

sources.title: Lattice Super Yang-Mills: A Virial Approach to Operator Dimensions

claims.name: one_loop_mixing_matrix_anomalous
claims.statement: The one loop mixing matrix for anomalous dimensions in $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills can be identified with the Hamiltonian of an integrable $SO(6)$ spin chain with vector sites.

sources.title: The Bethe-Ansatz for N=4 Super Yang-Mills
